children: Our Bureau Mumbai: Axis Bank has appointed Rahul Shukla as Group Head, Commercial and Bharat Banking, effective October 19, 2026. Shukla, 57, will be responsible for accelerating growth, deepening customer relationships and strengthening the bank's presence across its commercial and Bharat banking businesses, the lender said.

A banker with over three decades of experience, Shukla previously led Commercial & Rural Banking and Wholesale Banking at HDFC Bank. Before that, he held senior leadership roles at Citi, including head of South Asia Corporate Bank and Asia-Pacific TMT Investment Banking.
